context: Plans the closeout review with the slopguard CLI: one Codex review at medium reasoning in branch mode against main, the distilled contract on stdin, JSON output, and no provider fallback.

checklist.name: Slopguard branch review
checklist.description: The exact command is `slopguard review` with `--mode branch --base main` (or a resolved main ref), not a direct codex, claude, or grok invocation

checklist.name: Codex at medium
checklist.description: With no user or configured choice, closeout.md picks Codex (`--engine codex`) as the single reviewer and states medium reasoning effort as the default

checklist.name: Contract on stdin, JSON out
checklist.description: The command pipes the distilled acceptance criteria through standard input with `--prompt-file -` and requests `--output json`

checklist.name: Unfiltered findings requested
checklist.description: The prompt asks the reviewer for every suspected finding regardless of severity or confidence

checklist.name: No fallback or panel
checklist.description: On review failure the plan reports the blocker and does not automatically switch to Claude or Grok, run several reviewers, or claim consensus
